title: Selected Abstracts from the 2018 NCRI Cancer Conference of National Cancer Research Institute
abstract: Scottish Event Campus, Glasgow, Sunday 4 - Tuesday 6 November 2018 Attendees of the 2018 NCRI Cancer Conference will be able to contact corresponding authors through the Conference App and e-poster platform at the Conference.W: https://conference.ncri.org.uk : E: conference@ncri.org.ukOrganised by the National Cancer Research Institute, which is a partnership of 19 cancer research funders, the NCRI Cancer Conference provides a platform for researchers, clinicians, people affected by cancer and industry representatives to come together to discuss, present and showcase high-quality research. Sponsorship Statement: Publication of this supplement was sponsored by Roche. All content was reviewed and approved by the NCRI Scientific Committee, which held full responsibility for the abstract selection.
